title: The Crates That Arrived Empty
central_conflict: harvest crates reached the barn with their lids closed but fruit missing
decisive_choice: a loose panel in the cart floor let fruit roll out along the road
resolution: repaired the cart floor and collected the fallen fruit
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered harvest crates reached the barn with their lids closed but fruit missing before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they tightened the lids but the losses continued; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a loose panel in the cart floor let fruit roll out along the road; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they repaired the cart floor and collected the fallen fruit, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Letter That Appeared Blank
central_conflict: the archive's emergency instructions looked blank under ordinary lamps
decisive_choice: the archivist discovered that the writing used a pigment visible under angled blue light
resolution: photographed the recovered text and made accessible permanent copies

title: The Pool That Emptied at High Tide
central_conflict: the coastal nursery's tidal pool drained whenever the tide rose
decisive_choice: a submerged siphon tube connected the pool to a lower drainage trench
resolution: capped the unintended siphon and restored a safe overflow channel
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the coastal nursery's tidal pool drained whenever the tide rose before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they piled stones around its rim but the water still vanished; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a submerged siphon tube connected the pool to a lower drainage trench; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they capped the unintended siphon and restored a safe overflow channel, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
